hook: Dinner served, dinner gone? Not anymore.
caption:
#ad Swipe through to see how this textured bowl turns quick gulps into a long mealtime. Spreading wet food across the soft rubber bumps keeps your dog busy during bath time or quiet moments. It is made for gentle lickers rather than dogs that chew soft rubber.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/
brief: Wobble lick bowl for dogs: a rubber bowl full of small bumps. Spread wet food or a treat paste into the bumps, and licking it up takes longer, so fast eaters slow down and mealtime lasts. Good for fast eaters, bath time and quiet time. Not for dogs that chew or tear soft rubber. Playful tone: dinner served, dinner gone. This is a 5-slide swipe post, so the first sentence should invite people to swipe through.
